subject: Request: Pilot extension + combined credit & discount concession for Orchard Analytics
messages:
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@orchardanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot status & ask: extension + credits + discount

Ben —

Quick status from our side: the trial has been promising; engineering confirmed the Redwood model reduced inference latency on our NLU pipelines by ~28% in our staging tests. We do need a little more runway to finish the integration and a procurement conversation for terms. Two asks:

1) Extend the pilot 6 weeks (from 7/1 to 8/12).
2) Combine a one-time credit to cover extra usage during extension (we're estimating ~60k tokens/week) and a usage discount on the first three paid months to help justify the spend to finance.

If you can provide a combined concession (credits + a short-term discount) we can get procurement and legal moving and sign the amendment. Lina will be the procurement lead on this.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week if needed.

— Sanjay
Sanjay Mehta
Head of ML, Orchard Analytics
[sent from mobile]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@orchardanalytics.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina@orchardanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot status & ask: extension + credits + discount

Sanjay —

Really glad the latency gains are showing up in your staging tests. We can certainly explore an onramp package that pairs an extension with credits and a transient discount. Before I put this into the exec queue I need to confirm two things with you so I can propose numbers:

- Expected token burn during the 6-week extension (your note said ~60k tokens/week; confirm rough upper bound)
- Expected go/no-go decision milestone (what date does procurement need an OK to keep roadmap on track?)

If it's helpful, I can propose a conservative concession to move this forward and ask for a fast-track exec review.

I’ll loop in our deal ops so we can prepare the amendment.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[attachment: orchard_requested_concession_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot status & ask: extension + credits + discount — exec approval request

Marissa / Aditya —

Forwarding a request from Orchard Analytics (DEAL-2027-0154). Summary and ask:

- Pilot extension: 6 weeks (7/1 — 8/12)
- One-time token credit to offset extra usage during extension (customer estimates ~60k tokens/week; ~360k tokens total)
- Short-term usage discount for the first 3 paid months after pilot (customer requested 25%)

Why we should consider: strong product fit signal, NLU latency improvements materially impact their core product metric; procurement is ready to move if we can provide a clear concession.

Risk: this is a combined credit + discount ask which impacts near-term unit economics; recommend approval only with defined guardrails (caps & rollback triggers).

Proposed conservative concession (my recommendation):
- One-time credit: 40,000 tokens (applied to pilot usage only)
- Discount: 15% off list for first 3 months post-pilot
- Condition: credit exhausted or 8/12 end date — whichever comes first; contract amendment for a 3-month paid commitment at the end of pilot (to be captured in amendment).

Attachments: concession summary (customer request) and a draft amendment template for redline.

Asking for your approval (Marissa) and any pricing carveouts (Aditya) to proceed to procurement/legal.

Thanks —
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot status & ask: extension + credits + discount — exec approval request

Ben —

Thanks for the concise ask. A few quick clarifying Qs before I sign off:

1) What's the projected ARR uplift (even conservatively) if Orchard converts after the pilot? Need this to model payback vs concession.
2) Is there an existing commitment path (PO/term) in the pipeline — can we reasonably expect a 3-month paid commitment per your condition?
3) Can Deal Ops gate the concession behind a simple KPI (e.g., conversion to paid within 60 days post-8/12)?

If answers are within expected ranges I’m comfortable approving a limited concession. With that said, MarCom and Finance prefer discounts capped at 20% and one-time credits treated as contra-revenue for Q3 — so your proposed 40k credit + 15% discount is within those guardrails.

Please supply quick numbers and I’ll greenlight the amendment.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot status & ask: extension + credits + discount — exec approval request

Marissa —

Quick answers inline: 

1) Conservative ARR uplift estimate: if Orchard converts at the run-rate we’ve seen in their POC, expected first-year ARR is ~$180k (conservative). With a 15% margin hit from the concession the NPV still looks accretive assuming a 12–18 month retention horizon.

2) Commitment path: procurement has indicated they will do a paid proof if we can provide the concession and amendment; Lina (procurement) said finance needs the pricing concession to get internal sign-off. We do not yet have a signed PO.

3) KPI gating: propose a conversion clause — if Orchard does not convert to a paid plan representing at least $50k ARR within 60 days of pilot end (8/12), we automatically retract the discount for subsequent billing cycles and note the credit as one-time non-recurring concession. Deal Ops can implement the clause in the amendment.

Numbers summary (proposed to send to Marissa for sign-off):
- One-time pilot credit: 40,000 tokens (applied during extension only)
- Discount: 15% off list pricing for first 3 paid months post-pilot
- KPI: 60-day conversion to >= $50k ARR, else discount void
- Accounting treatment: credit recorded as contra-revenue Q3; discount limited to 3 months

If that sits well, can I get your approval to update the amendment and route to legal?

Thanks,
Ben

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot status & ask: extension + credits + discount — exec approval request

Ben / Marissa —

Appreciate the clear framing and the guardrails. Approve the proposed concession with one modification: increase the one-time credit to 50,000 tokens (to help them finish integration work) but keep the discount at 15% and the KPI gate as-is. Please ensure Deal Ops inserts the conversion KPI and a clawback mechanism into the amendment.

I will flag this to CFO for awareness but do not require further exec signatures unless Legal requests broader commercial changes.

Ben — please proceed and route the updated amendment to Orchard's procurement (Lina) and cc me on the DocuSign envelope.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of North America Sales, Redwood Inference
